## Pull Request Checklist

### Description
- **What changed**:
- **Why**:
- **Milestone**: [ ] M0  [ ] M1  [ ] M2  [ ] M3  [ ] M4  [ ] M5  [ ] M6

### Review & Governance
- [ ] **Contract changed?** (If yes, both Prajit and Shoaib must approve)
- [ ] **Automated tests** added or updated
- [ ] **UI changes**: Screenshots attached (if applicable)
- [ ] **No secrets**: Verified no credentials, private keys, or config secrets are included
